VPN Price Comparison Update: Best Deals This Month

The VPN market is heating up with aggressive promotions, and we've tracked every major deal to help you find genuine savings. Our team at Zero to VPN has personally tested 50+ services and identified which discounts actually deliver value—and which are marketing smoke. In this month's roundup, we're seeing savings up to 72% on annual plans, but not all deals are created equal.

Key Takeaways

Question Answer
Which VPN offers the best deal this month? Our analysis shows multi-year plans from top-tier providers offer the highest real savings. Check our VPN comparison tool for current rates.
What's the average VPN price today? Premium VPN subscriptions typically range from $3–$12/month on annual plans. Monthly pricing averages $10–$15/month without commitment.
How do I know if a VPN deal is real? Compare the per-month cost across plan lengths, check refund policies, and verify no hidden fees. We test every claim independently.
Are budget VPNs worth the savings? Budget options can work for basic browsing, but premium services offer better security features, faster speeds, and more server locations.
What payment methods offer extra discounts? Some providers offer 5–10% additional discounts for cryptocurrency payments or annual prepayment. Check individual provider sites for current offers.
How long do these deals last? Most promotional pricing is valid 30–90 days from purchase. We include expiration context for each deal below.
Can I stack coupons with sale pricing? Rarely. Providers typically apply the best available discount automatically; stacking additional codes usually isn't permitted.

1. NordVPN Annual Plan – Premium Security at a Discount

NordVPN remains one of the most recognized VPN providers globally, and their current annual promotion reflects strong market confidence. We've been using NordVPN consistently for the past 18 months across multiple devices, and the service delivers reliable performance across streaming, torrenting, and everyday browsing. Their infrastructure spans 6,000+ servers in 111 countries, giving users genuine geographic flexibility.

The deal structure this month prioritizes long-term commitment, which aligns with how premium VPN services typically operate. We've noted that the per-month effective cost drops significantly when spreading the annual fee across 12 months, compared to monthly renewal rates.

Deal Breakdown and Savings

Original Price: $11.99/month (month-to-month)
Deal Price: $3.99/month (annual plan)
Total Annual Cost: $47.88
Savings: 66.7% off standard rates
Deal Expiration: Valid through end of month (verify on provider site for current dates)
Deal Score: 9.2/10

What You're Actually Getting

At this price point, NordVPN includes their full feature set: 256-bit AES encryption, no-logs policy (independently audited), and access to their Double VPN feature for additional security layers. In practice, we've found the connection speeds remain competitive even during peak hours, and the app interface is intuitive for both beginners and advanced users.

  • Multi-device support: Covers up to 6 simultaneous connections, suitable for families or power users
  • Streaming optimization: Dedicated servers for Netflix, Disney+, and other platforms perform reliably in our testing
  • Kill switch technology: Automatic disconnection if VPN drops prevents data leaks
  • 30-day money-back guarantee: Low-risk trial period to evaluate the service
  • Native apps: Available on Windows, macOS, iOS, Android, and Linux with consistent feature parity

2. ExpressVPN Speed-Focused Bundle – Best for Streaming

ExpressVPN has built its reputation on connection speed and streaming capability, and their current promotional bundle reflects this positioning. During our extended testing period, ExpressVPN consistently delivered faster throughput than competitors in the same price tier, particularly on their Lightway protocol. The service maintains servers in 105 countries, with particular emphasis on regions with high streaming demand.

What distinguishes ExpressVPN this month is their bundled offer combining VPN access with their MediaStreamer service, which adds flexibility for smart TV and router-level protection. This represents better value than purchasing components separately.

Deal Structure and Value Proposition

Original Price: $12.95/month (standard annual)
Deal Price: $6.67/month (12-month plan with MediaStreamer bundle)
Total Annual Cost: $80.04
Savings: 48.5% off combined services
Deal Expiration: Promotional pricing guaranteed for initial 12 months
Deal Score: 8.7/10

Performance and Practical Benefits

In real-world usage, we've measured ExpressVPN's speed advantage most noticeably when accessing geo-restricted content. Their proprietary Lightway protocol reduces latency compared to OpenVPN, which matters for streaming quality. The MediaStreamer component enables VPN-like protection on devices that don't support traditional VPN clients, such as Apple TV and PlayStation consoles.

  • Lightway protocol: Custom encryption standard designed for speed without sacrificing security
  • Split tunneling: Route some traffic through VPN while other apps connect normally, reducing bandwidth strain
  • Smart location selection: Automatic server routing optimizes for your use case
  • MediaStreamer DNS: Unblocks content on devices without native VPN support
  • 24/7 live chat support: Responsive customer service via real agents, not chatbots

With 3,200+ servers in 100 countries, coverage remains comprehensive.

The standout feature this month is Surfshark's unlimited simultaneous connections policy—a rarity in the VPN industry that provides genuine multi-device value. At this price, the economics become compelling for households with multiple users.

Features That Justify the Low Price

Skepticism about budget VPNs is warranted, but Surfshark's feature set contradicts the low price. When setting up the service, we found no artificial throttling or speed limitations—the connection performs as expected. The app includes modern security features like kill switch, no-logs policy, and DNS leak protection as standard.

  • Unlimited simultaneous connections: Single subscription covers entire household or all personal devices
  • CleanWeb feature: Built-in ad and malware blocking reduces need for separate security tools
  • Static IP option: Additional monthly fee provides dedicated IP for users needing consistent addresses
  • Camouflage mode: Masks VPN usage from ISPs and network administrators

5. ProtonVPN Privacy-First Option – Best for Security Conscious Users

ProtonVPN distinguishes itself through Swiss jurisdiction and ownership by Proton AG, the company behind ProtonMail encrypted email. This privacy-first positioning appeals to users prioritizing security over price, and their current promotion makes the premium tier more accessible. ProtonVPN maintains 3,000+ servers in 68 countries with emphasis on privacy-friendly jurisdictions.

The deal this month bundles VPN access with Proton's ecosystem, creating value for users already invested in their email or password manager services. We've tested the integration and found it seamless across devices.

Premium Security at Promotional Rates

Original Price: $9.99/month (Plus plan annual)
Deal Price: $4.99/month (Plus plan with annual commitment)
Total Annual Cost: $59.88
Savings: 50% off standard pricing
Deal Expiration: New subscriber promotional rate; standard rates apply on renewal
Deal Score: 8.5/10

Advanced Security Features and Transparency

ProtonVPN's appeal extends beyond pricing to their transparency practices. The company publishes regular transparency reports and maintains no-logs policies verified through independent audits. When setting up the service, users can choose from multiple encryption protocols including OpenVPN and their proprietary Stealth protocol designed to evade detection.

  • Secure Core routing: Encrypts traffic through multiple servers in privacy-friendly countries
  • Stealth protocol: Masks VPN usage from network administrators and ISPs
  • NetShield feature: Built-in ad and malware blocking at protocol level
  • Integrated email service: Seamless access to ProtonMail within VPN ecosystem
  • P2P/torrenting support: Dedicated servers optimized for file sharing without throttling

The service maintains 2,000+ servers across 75 countries with particular strength in US coverage. Our testing shows IPVanish delivers reliable performance for both general browsing and demanding use cases like remote work.

This month's promotion bundles standard VPN with a static IP address, which normally costs $3–$5 monthly as an add-on. The combined pricing represents genuine savings for users needing both components.

In practice, we've found the service maintains stable connections during extended sessions without unexpected disconnections. The dedicated IP component ensures your traffic appears to originate from a consistent address, useful for accessing services that flag frequent IP changes.

  • Dedicated IP allocation: Static address prevents blacklisting and enables consistent access to restricted services
  • SOCKS5 proxy included: Additional layer of anonymity for advanced users
  • Unlimited bandwidth: No throttling or data caps regardless of usage volume
  • Port forwarding: Advanced networking capability for specific applications

8. Mullvad Privacy Maximalist Choice – Best for Anonymity

Mullvad takes privacy to an extreme with their account-free model and Swedish jurisdiction, representing the privacy maximalist approach to VPN services. Rather than traditional pricing, Mullvad uses a fixed monthly rate with no account creation required—you generate an account number and can remain completely anonymous. Our testing confirms this unique model actually simplifies the user experience while maximizing privacy.

This month we're highlighting Mullvad not for a promotional discount, but because their pricing model itself represents exceptional value for privacy-focused users. The service maintains 400+ servers in 42 countries with emphasis on privacy-friendly jurisdictions.

Account-Free Model and True Anonymity

Pricing Model: Fixed monthly fee (no annual discounts)
Monthly Cost: $5.00/month
Annual Equivalent: $60.00/year
Unique Factor: No account creation, no email required, completely anonymous usage
Deal Expiration: Permanent pricing model; no promotional periods
Deal Score: 8.3/10

Privacy Through Radical Transparency

Mullvad's philosophy differs fundamentally from competitors—they prioritize privacy above all other considerations, even at the cost of convenience. In practice, this means no account recovery mechanisms, no password resets, and no user tracking. If you lose your account number, you lose access permanently, which sounds problematic until you realize this also means Mullvad literally cannot track you even if compelled legally.

  • Account-free operation: Generate random account numbers; no email or personal information required
  • Wireguard protocol: Modern encryption standard optimized for speed and security
  • Transparent logging: Third-party audits confirm zero activity logging
  • No kill switch: Mullvad philosophy is that VPN should never need one because it doesn't log anyway
  • Open-source apps: Code available for independent security verification

The current promotion discounts the paid tier significantly, making the upgrade economics compelling for users already familiar with the service. Windscribe maintains 600+ servers in 110 countries with strong focus on privacy.

How to Choose the Right Deal for Your Needs

Selecting the best VPN deal requires matching your specific use case against available options. Budget-conscious users should prioritize per-month cost, but also verify that essential features like kill switch, no-logs policy, and encryption standards are included. Streaming users should weight server optimization and speed testing results. Privacy-focused users might prioritize jurisdiction and transparency over raw savings percentage.

Our analysis shows that the absolute lowest price doesn't always deliver the best value. CyberGhost's 81.5% discount appears superior to NordVPN's 66.7% savings, but NordVPN's larger server network and streaming optimization might justify the higher per-month cost depending on your priorities. Consider your contract length comfort level—three-year deals offer maximum savings but lock you in if service quality declines.

Conclusion

This month's VPN market offers genuine opportunities for savings, with top-tier providers discounting 50-82% off standard rates. Our testing confirms these deals deliver real value—the promotional pricing doesn't represent stripped-down service tiers but rather full-featured access to the same infrastructure paying full price customers receive. The standout value propositions vary by use case: NordVPN for market-leading reliability, Surfshark for budget optimization, CyberGhost for streaming, and ProtonVPN for privacy maximization.

When evaluating deals, remember that lowest price alone doesn't determine best value. Consider refund policies (30-45 days is standard), simultaneous connection limits, server count, and specific features matching your use case. We recommend starting with our comprehensive VPN comparison tool to filter options by priority, then verify current promotional pricing on provider websites before purchasing.

At Zero to VPN, every recommendation comes from hands-on testing across 50+ services using consistent evaluation criteria. Our independent testing methodology ensures we identify genuine value rather than marketing hype. These deals represent legitimate savings on services we've personally validated for security, speed, and reliability. Lock in the savings before promotional periods expire—most offers remain valid 30-90 days from purchase.
